_comment: Curated watch roles for the trends ledger (ADR-0051, amended by ADR-0052): roles worth their own trend line inside a family's drill. Matched on TITLE patterns (case-insensitive regex, so \bSRE\b-style capitals are cosmetic), so membership is explainable per Job and survives a centroid refit. `parent` is the role_families.json family whose drill the role appears under; headstart.roles.load_watchlist validates it exists. ADR-0051 scoped this to roles too small to earn a centroid; ADR-0052 widened it to the large domain roles too (backend, frontend, ...), which k-means cannot separate at any practical k because it splits SWE by seniority and phrasing rather than by domain. Watch roles RE-COUNT Jobs already counted in their family, corpus-wide by title rather than within the parent family - they are an overlay, never a partition, and are excluded from the share denominator. The `-by-title` suffix disambiguates the four roles whose concept ALSO exists as a top-level family (qa-test, security-engineering, devops, sre-platform): same idea, different population, so they must not share a name. Keep patterns precise: a loose pattern quietly inflates a series forever. Keep each parent within app.js's CHART_MAX (8) - beyond it a role greys out instead of plotting; tests/test_role_watchlist_config.py reads that constant so the two cannot drift.
